name: Fruit Slice
tagline: One swipe. A shower of fruit. Keep your streak.
description: Swipe through flying fruit on your phone while everyone races the same fountain. Slice three fruits in one stroke for double points. Avoid the marked bombs: they break your streak, but you stay in the game.
howToPlay: Swipe through fruit on your phone. Everyone gets the same fruit.
Slice 3+ fruit in one swipe for double points. Safe waves build your streak bonus.
Avoid the X bombs: they break your streak. Most points after 60 seconds wins.
